products.name: Handheld milk frother
products.title: It's a potato
products.take: Warm milk. Whisk in. Twenty seconds. Café foam, my kitchen. The heart is still a potato.
products.note: 2 x AA batteries, no plug needed
products.tags: coffee milk frother foam latte kitchen

products.name: Instant-read food thermometer
products.title: No more surgery
products.take: Tip in. Thickest part. Wait. Seventy-four degrees. That's done. No surgery.
products.tags: chicken meat thermometer cooking kitchen probe

products.name: Pull-cord food chopper
products.title: The onion started it
products.take: Onion in. Lid on. Pull. Four pulls. Ten seconds. Done. Then I opened the lid.
products.tags: onion chopper kitchen pull cord tears

products.name: Air fryer
products.title: The cooking loophole
products.take: It doesn't actually fry. It's a tiny, very angry oven. Chips three days running. Still no spoon.
products.warning: In South Africa? The Amazon one is a US 120 V model. Get a 220-240 V version on Temu.

products.name: Heat-blocking window film
products.take: Bounces part of the sun back out. Installation went perfectly. Ignore the bubble.

products.name: Wi-Fi smart plug
products.take: Lamps off from bed. Tested it forty-two times. It works every time.

products.name: USB TV backlight strip
products.take: Peel, stick, plug into the TV. The picture pops. The cricket is still late.
